split_scope_note: Samples are grouped by deformation state across volume fractions. If this test split informs model selection, reserve new grouped deformation states for the final independent evaluation.

training_config.model_symmetry_assumption: isotropic in F, conditioned on volume fraction
training_config.reference_normalization: objective pressure correction using trace(P_raw(I))/3 times (det(F)-1)
training_config.tangent_loss: mean squared per-sample relative Frobenius error
training_config.tangent_sampling: half detF<0.70, half detF>=0.70 when available
